description: How an SDK sends an agent's tool call to the gateway's /sdk face, what it concludes from each answer (only allow, and observe for a built-in tool, let the call run), what it sends a target-enforced connection's target, and how it renews its token and waits at the server.
source: the /sdk/{connection} face of tracks S and C (internal/gateway/sdk; G0 M8 decision 19, HR-200, HR-201), internal/actionir for hashes, internal/authority/finalize for the action token and internal/gen protojson for the server exchanges
